messages.text: What's the word/phrase/synonym for "make it up to you" in: let me make it up to you

A few options depending on the vibe you want:

**Single words:** atone, amend, recompense, compensate, redress

**Phrases:** make amends, make good, set things right, square things, even the score, make it right, make reparations

"Let me make amends" is probably the closest direct swap — it carries the same apologetic, relationship-repair feeling. "Let me make it right" is the most natural-sounding modern alternative.
